threads.body: This change removes the `messaging.destination.subscription.name` attribute from the `messaging.client.operation.duration` metric definition. If the instrumentation list is used as a contract by generators/consumers, dropping an attribute can be a breaking change (dashboards/alerts may stop grouping correctly). Consider keeping the attribute and marking it deprecated (or gating it behind the same stability/feature flag mechanism used elsewhere) rather than removing it outright.
threads.hunk:
@@ -2033,8 +2033,6 @@ definitions:
       attributes:
       - name: messaging.destination.name
         type: STRING
-      - name: messaging.destination.subscription.name
-        type: STRING
       - name: messaging.operation.name
         type: STRING
       - name: messaging.operation.type

threads.body: The JVM metric refs appear grouped (CPU metrics followed by memory metrics). Adding `jvm.gc.duration` in between breaks that grouping, making the list harder to scan and maintain. Consider moving `jvm.gc.duration` to a GC-related block (or keeping the full list consistently ordered/grouped) so future updates remain predictable.
